form.label: Detection Coverage
form.description: What was caught, and which of it is worth opening first. A host showing activity across several stages of an intrusion matters more than the same number of unrelated detections spread across a fleet.

search.query: index=sigma_alerts $plat_tok$ $sev_tok$ $host_tok$ | lookup sigma_rules sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_technique_name, sigma_tactic_name, sigma_confidence_score, sigma_disposition, sigma_platform | eval tactic = if(sigma_tactic_name="" OR isnull(sigma_tactic_name), "Unmapped", trim(mvindex(split(sigma_tactic_name,","),0))), technique = if(sigma_technique_name="" OR isnull(sigma_technique_name), "no technique mapped", sigma_technique_name), stage = case(tactic=="Reconnaissance",1, tactic=="Resource Development",2, tactic=="Initial Access",3, tactic=="Execution",4, tactic=="Persistence",5, tactic=="Privilege Escalation",6, tactic=="Defense Evasion",7, tactic=="Credential Access",8, tactic=="Discovery",9, tactic=="Lateral Movement",10, tactic=="Collection",11, tactic=="Command and Control",12, tactic=="Exfiltration",13, tactic=="Impact",14, 1==1,15), stage_label = printf("%02d",stage)." ".tactic, weight = case(sigma_level=="critical",10, sigma_level=="high",6, sigma_level=="medium",3, 1==1,1) * (coalesce(tonumber(sigma_confidence_score),50)/100)
| stats dc(tactic) as stages by sigma_src_host | where stages >= 2 | stats count
| search technique!="no technique mapped" | stats dc(technique)

panel.title: Hosts ranked by what the detections together suggest

search.query: | stats sum(weight) as base, dc(tactic) as stages, count as detections, dc(sigma_rule) as rules, values(stage_label) as seen, min(sigma_first_seen) as first, max(sigma_last_seen) as last by sigma_src_host | eval risk = round(base * (1 + (stages - 1) * 0.6), 1), window = tostring(last - first, "duration"), first = strftime(first, "%F %T"), reading = case(stages >= 3, "multi-stage activity — investigate", stages == 2, "two stages — corroborate", detections >= 5, "repeated single-stage — likely noisy rule", 1==1, "isolated") | sort - risk | table sigma_src_host, risk, stages, detections, rules, reading, first, window, seen | rename sigma_src_host as "Host", risk as "Risk", stages as "Stages", detections as "Detections", rules as "Rules", reading as "What it suggests", first as "First seen", window as "Spanning", seen as "Stages seen"

format.colorPalette: {"multi-stage activity — investigate":#d03b3b,"two stages — corroborate":#ec835a,"repeated single-stage — likely noisy rule":#fab219,"isolated":#19C1EB}

panel.title: Kill-chain progression — where each host sits

search.query: | chart count over sigma_src_host by stage_label

panel.title: When it happened, and how severe

search.query: | timechart span=1h count by sigma_level useother=f

panel.title: Rules that fire together — candidates to treat as one finding

search.query: | bin _time span=10m | stats dc(sigma_rule) as rules_in_window, values(sigma_rule) as rule_set, sum(sigma_match_count) as events by _time, sigma_src_host | where rules_in_window >= 2 | eval window=strftime(_time,"%F %H:%M") | sort - rules_in_window, - events | table window, sigma_src_host, rules_in_window, events, rule_set | rename window as "10-minute window", sigma_src_host as "Host", rules_in_window as "Rules", events as "Events", rule_set as "Fired together"

panel.title: Coverage against telemetry — what could fire, and what cannot

search.query: | inputlookup sigma_rules.csv | stats count as rules by sigma_platform, sigma_log_source | join type=left sigma_log_source [ search index=sigma_alerts earliest=$tr.earliest$ latest=$tr.latest$ | lookup sigma_rules sigma_rule_id OUTPUT sigma_log_source | stats count as detections by sigma_log_source ] | eval detections = coalesce(detections, 0), state = if(detections > 0, "producing detections", "nothing has fired") | sort - rules | head 12 | table sigma_platform, sigma_log_source, rules, detections, state | rename sigma_platform as "Platform", sigma_log_source as "Log source", rules as "Rules deployed", detections as "Detections", state as "State"

panel.title: Most recent — click a row for the events behind it

search.query: | eval when=strftime(sigma_first_seen,"%F %T"), over=if(sigma_span_seconds<=0,"single event",tostring(sigma_span_seconds,"duration")) | table when, sigma_src_host, sigma_rule, technique, tactic, sigma_level, sigma_match_count, over, sigma_src_sourcetype | rename when as "When", sigma_src_host as "Host", sigma_rule as "Rule", technique as "ATT&CK technique", tactic as "Tactic", sigma_level as "Severity", sigma_match_count as "Events", over as "Over", sigma_src_sourcetype as "Source type" | sort - "When"
